lines.t: When you said, what's the deal?
You showed me where you stood
You kept the rules to keep yourself
Not because you knew my good
You trimmed your lamb by habit
Not by hunger for my flame
You spoke my name with practiced lips
You never saw me as I really am
You thought my patience meant my favor
You thought nearness came from calling Lord
You built a world of borrowed life
And claimed it as reward
You did not know me
Though I saw straight through you
You kept me distant
With custom made truth
You loved the likeness
Not the life I gave
You did not know me
Yet still I am not changed
I hear the whisper rising in you
But I meant well, I tried
You shaped a God to fit your wants
And call that hope you got
You wanted me for comfort
Not to walk where I would lead
Crosses decorate your halls
Pick up yours and follow me
And when you cried you left us here
You spoke from whom you chose
For pride locked your inner door
Long before my clothes
You did not know me
Though I saw straight through you
You kept me distant
With custom-made truths
You loved the likeness
Not the life I gained
you did not know me yet i am forever the same i have not forsaken you but you have not yet turned
you feel abandoned in your dark but this is how pride burns my child i was beside you when your
lips cried out my name but nearness isn't claimed by habit it's forged in holy flame
You did not know me, though I saw straight through you
You kept me distant with custom-made truths
You loved an image, not my living way
But when you yield, I will not stay away
Way away
When you want me as I am
I'll call your name again
You did not know me
Though I saw straight through you
You kept me distant with custom-made truths
You loved the likeness, not the life I gave
You did not know me, my child, I cannot change
I can never change
